Jordan (PM): Quick sync — we need to finalize the staged EU rollout for the new routing fallback (Feature X). Canaries, flag gates, A/B variant check, and explicit fallback policy. Proposal below; need ack + owners.

Anna (Product): Proposed cadence: canary cohorts 5% -> 25% -> 100% over 2 weeks. Gates: error_rate, p50/p95 latency, token cost delta. Telemetry thresholds: error_rate > 0.8% for 10m = rollback; p95 latency increase > 20% relative to baseline for 15m = pause.

Eli (Eng): Implementation plan: one feature flag per region + an "auto-evict" flag. Flag names:
```
prod.feature_x.enabled.eu-west
prod.feature_x.enabled.eu-central
prod.feature_x.auto_evict
```
Canary config stored in launch-config repo; can we do rollout with weighted routing? Will need KV cache warmers for eu regions.

Mike (SRE): Ops constraints: need region-level circuit breaker. If eu-west canary fails, traffic should fall back to global model in us-west with rate limit. Suggested rules:
- If error_rate > 1% or p95 > 500ms for 5m -> evict region -> reroute
- Eviction auto-retry after 30m with 10% probe traffic
Also: add capacity buffer on dedicated clusters, alert on >70% GPU util during canary.

Anna (Product): QA list: canary-kill switch in shiproom, smoke test deck in /qa/canaries, run shadow A/B for 48h with 0% traffic to capture regressions, and a small user-facing A/B (metric: conversion of calls success) at 5% for 72h.

Jordan (PM): Decision needed: keep A/B variant or just feature flag toggle? Customer asks prefer deterministic fallback to older model versus variable A/B. Thoughts?

Eli (Eng): Prefer deterministic fallback for initial launch to simplify debugging. We can enable A/B after stable.

Mike (SRE): +1 deterministic -> easier SLOs. Also add an automatic model-variant fallback map in router config (priority list).

ops-bot: deploy-bot: Canary queue created: eu-west cohort 5% scheduled at 1724250030

Anna (Product): I'll own the rollout runbook. Eli -> engineering lead. Mike -> ops on-call. Jordan -> launch decision.

Jordan (PM): Sounds good. Quick action items:
- Anna: write runbook + telemetry thresholds (ETA EOD)
- Eli: flag + routing config PR (ETA 2d)
- Mike: automation for eviction + probe (ETA 3d)

Anna (Product): noted. Will ping when runbook draft is in #docs-review :thumbsup:

Mike (SRE): I'll add the alert runbook and schedule load test window with infra.

Jordan (PM): Thanks — track in the rollout epic and we'll reconvene after the first canary burn (add to calendar for 2 days post-start).
